-- fetch all contacts with retry
local all, page, total_pages = {}, 1, 1
while page <= total_pages do
  local ok, r = pcall(tool, 'list_contacts', { page = page })
  local tries = 0
  while not ok and tries < 5 do
    tries = tries + 1
    ok, r = pcall(tool, 'list_contacts', { page = page })
  end
  if not ok then return { error = tostring(r), page = page } end
  total_pages = r.total_pages
  for _, c in ipairs(r.items) do all[#all + 1] = c end
  page = page + 1
end

local companies = {
  ['acme.com'] = 'Acme Corporation',
  ['globex.io'] = 'Globex',
  ['initech.dev'] = 'Initech',
  ['umbrella.co'] = 'Umbrella Holdings',
}

local phones_fixed, companies_filled, updates = 0, 0, {}
for _, c in ipairs(all) do
  local upd = { id = c.id }
  local need = false

  -- phone: valid E.164 = +1 followed by exactly 10 digits
  if not c.phone:match('^%+1%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$') then
    local digits = c.phone:gsub('%D', '')
    if #digits == 11 and digits:sub(1,1) == '1' then digits = digits:sub(2) end
    upd.phone = '+1' .. digits
    phones_fixed = phones_fixed + 1
    need = true
  end

  -- company: fill if empty
  if c.company == '' then
    local domain = c.email:match('@(.+)$')
    upd.company = companies[domain]
    companies_filled = companies_filled + 1
    need = true
  end

  if need then updates[#updates + 1] = upd end
end

-- apply updates
local results = {}
for _, u in ipairs(updates) do
  local ok, r = pcall(tool, 'update_contact', u)
  local tries = 0
  while not ok and tries < 5 do
    tries = tries + 1
    ok, r = pcall(tool, 'update_contact', u)
  end
  results[#results + 1] = ok and r or { error = tostring(r), id = u.id }
end

return { phones_fixed = phones_fixed, companies_filled = companies_filled, applied = #results, results = results }
